opening.argument: The presentation invites participants to place their full Bitcoin investment into a trading account in exchange for passive income from daily trading activities. It instructs viewers to register and fund the account with Bitcoin, imposes a seven-day funding condition, and provides a referral registration URL. It further describes withdrawals being sent to a Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours and directs participants to contact the sender for assistance. Although it qualifies future returns as dependent on positive trading results and says they are not guaranteed, the overall offer remains one of passive daily Bitcoin earnings through a funded account. The record does not establish that funds were accepted, trades occurred, withdrawals were completed, or the claimed affiliation and service operation were verified.

citations.quote: Your FULL bitcoin investment goes into your trading account. MTI provides you with a passive income opportunity. Earn passively from daily trading activities.
To start you will need to register with MTI, and fund your account with Bitcoin. The suggested minimum is $100 worth of Bitcoin.
Your requested amount will be sent to your Bitcoin wallet within 48 hours.
